headline: Sarthak Metals, Sterling Tools, and Pix Transmissions rally up to 16%
hook: Small-cap stocks surge on heavy trading volume
summary: Sarthak Metals, Sterling Tools, and Pix Transmissions recorded gains of up to 16% during the trading session. The price movement is attributed to strong momentum and increased buying interest in these small-cap stocks. These companies operate in the industrial and engineering components space. Retail investors should note that such high-momentum moves in small-cap stocks often involve significant volatility.
why_it_matters: High volatility in small-caps increases risk for retail portfolios.
winners_losers: Shareholders gain / New buyers face high volatility
